697d999cda23e6a6.description: About us Specialized, disciplined, and driven by measurable growth across every engagement. Ektis, founded in 2025, is a financial services consulting firm built on decades of combined industry experience. Our diverse team of specialists brings deep sector expertise across the regional financial ecosystem, enabling us to turn complex challenges into practical, high-impact solutions. As an expert-led, boutique firm, we operate as an extension of our clients - partnering closely with financial institutions to translate ambition into measurable progress. We focus on building enduring internal capability and applying creative problem-solving that delivers lasting impact. Our approach integrates real-world insights with strategic thinking and disciplined execution. We define objectives with precision, map the pathways required, and deliver outcomes that work in practice - not just in presentation decks. Every deliverable is designed to be actionable, professional, and reflective of the capability and results our clients aim to achieve. Our Vision Redefining financial services consulting for a new era - accelerating ideas, deepening execution, and driving outcomes that matter. Our Mission We partner with financial institutions to turn ambition into measurable results. Guided by our entrepreneurial spirit, we integrate with client teams and combine strategic clarity, disciplined execution, and creative problem-solving to deliver lasting impact and build capabilities that endure Role Focus As a Senior Business Analyst at Ektis, you will play a pivotal role in supporting and leading consulting engagements across the financial services, fintech, and public-sector landscape. Each client brings a unique challenge, resulting in diverse projects in scope, length, and complexity. This gives you the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across multiple sectors while developing a strong problem-solving toolkit. You will work within a highly collaborative, agile, and entrepreneurial environment. At Ektis, we value authenticity, curiosity, and ownership - you will have the freedom to make your mark, contribute ideas, and help shape impactful solutions for our clients and communities. Key Responsibilities Drive analytical workstreams, including data collection, quantitative analysis, market research, and competitive assessments. Support the design and development of client recommendations by collaborating closely with project teams and client stakeholders across various industries. Contribute to business development efforts through proposal creation, client pitches, and case study development. Develop internal and external knowledge assets, including thought-leadership, frameworks, and research papers. Take part in firm-building activities such as recruiting, coaching junior team members, and supporting internal capability development. Candidate Profile We believe great consultants combine analytical rigor with empathy, curiosity, and strong communication. At Ektis, we look for individuals who challenge assumptions, think critically, and bring a collaborative mindset. You are an ideal candidate if you: Are eager to contribute ideas and take ownership from day one Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills Can prioritize effectively and thrive in fast-paced environments Bring a minimum of 2 years of professional experience in consulting, financial services, strategy, or related fields Hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Public Policy, or related disciplines Are fluent in English (Arabic is a strong plus) Are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills Ektis Competency Framework Our Competency Framework provides a transparent view of the behaviors and capabilities we expect at each grade, supporting growth, development and clarity across the firm. Senior Business Analysts are expected to build growing independence, confidence and ownership across the following five areas: Technical Capabilities – Structured problem solving, analytical rigor, strong synthesis, and producing credible, insight-driven outputs. Delivery Excellence – Managing modules effectively; contributing to planning and execution; supporting BAs and Analysts; and helping maintain a balanced, sustainable working environment. Effective Communication – Clear, concise verbal, written and visual communication, with the ability to present sections of work and support client storylines. Client Relations – Building early trust with client stakeholders; participating confidently in interviews, workshops and discussions; and demonstrating professionalism and maturity. Ektis Spirit – Demonstrating our values and behaviors, showing initiative and ownership, and contributing actively to team culture, knowledge-sharing and firm building. What we can offer you At Ektis, our people work every day to make a meaningful difference for clients, colleagues, and the financial services ecosystem. We support them through a competitive compensation package and a range of benefits designed to help them grow and thrive, including: Competitive compensation and performance-based rewards Comprehensive health insurance coverage Structured learning, mentorship, and on-the-job development opportunities Exposure to high-impact engagements in financial services and beyond A supportive, entrepreneurial culture with opportunities for mobility, innovation, and flexible work arrangements

695e3aea9f5531d7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان أمن المنشأة وحماية ممتلكاتها، من خلال تطبيق الإجراءات الأمنية ومراقبة الدخول والخروج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل لتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ. التجول بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في المنشأة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تطبيق الإجراءات الأمنية بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في الملاحظة والتواصل. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في مكة المكرمة، ويتطلب الدور الالتزام بالدوام الكامل لضمان استمرارية العمليات الأمنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة.

6984c834b5f9b382.description: About Us A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. From the multi-cultural strength of our global organisation to the sustainable and innovative ways we work to bring people together, there’s something for everyone to get stuck into. And that’s where you come in. Job Description: Contract Manager Our Legal, Contracts & Compliance team in Saudi Arabia is growing! At Hitachi Rail, we are expanding our team to support some of the most exciting railway signaling projects in the region and we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in international environments, tackling challenges and helping deliver infrastructure that moves cities forward. Job Objective The Contract Manager is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of contractual activities related to large-scale railway signaling projects in Saudi Arabia. The role ensures that all contractual obligations, rights, risks, and opportunities are effectively managed in alignment with project objectives and corporate governance. The position supports project delivery by safeguarding the company’s commercial interests, ensuring contractual compliance, managing claims and variations, and fostering collaborative relationships with clients, partners, and subcontractors. The Contract Manager acts as a strategic advisor to project leadership, contributing to risk mitigation, dispute avoidance, and the successful execution of complex infrastructure projects. Roles & Responsibilities Lead the contract management function for railway signaling projects from contract award through project completion and close-out. Ensure compliance with contractual terms, corporate policies, and applicable legal frameworks throughout the project lifecycle. Provide commercial and contractual guidance to project directors, engineering teams, and senior management. Identify, assess, and manage contractual risks and opportunities, implementing mitigation strategies where necessary. Manage contractual correspondence, notifications, and documentation with clients, partners, and subcontractors. Lead the preparation, evaluation, and negotiation of contract variations, change orders, and claims. Support the development and execution of claims and dispute resolution strategies, including negotiation and settlement processes. Monitor project performance against contractual obligations and ensure timely identification of potential contractual issues. Coordinate with legal, finance, procurement, and project management teams to ensure consistent contractual governance. Manage subcontractor and supplier contracts, ensuring alignment with the main contract and project objectives. Contribute to commercial reporting, forecasting, and risk assessments related to contractual matters. Ensure proper contract administration procedures and documentation control in accordance with company standards. Support project leadership in stakeholder management and contract negotiations with clients and consortium partners. Work Experience Requirements 3 – 10 years of professional experience in contract management, in multinational companies, preferably within large infrastructure or railway projects. Proven experience managing complex EPC, turnkey, or railway signaling contracts in international project environments. Demonstrated track record in contract administration, claims management, and dispute resolution. Experience working with public sector clients and large infrastructure contracts, preferably in Saudi Arabia. Strong understanding of project delivery models and commercial risk management in large-scale transportation projects. Qualification, Certification & Educational Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Law, Engineering or a related field. Master’s degree in Law, Business Administration (MBA), or Project Management is considered an advantage. Fluency in Arabic and English. Work location is Makkah city in Saudi Arabia. Preferably a Saudi national. Professional certifications or trainings in commercial/contract management are highly desirable. Additional training or certification in FIDIC contract management or international construction law is considered beneficial. Preferred Skills Strong expertise in contractual frameworks commonly used in infrastructure projects (e.g., FIDIC or GTPL based contracts). Advanced negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Strong stakeholder management and communication capabilities. Ability to operate in complex, multicultural project environments and manage multiple contractual interfaces. Strategic mindset with the ability to balance commercial protection and collaborative project delivery. What can we offer? Work in a multinational company with affiliate companies all over the world. Attractive salary that reflects your expertise, plus additional perks that enhance your overall package. Performance-based yearly discretionary bonus plan. Medical and life insurance for you and your family. We support your children’s education with our schooling allowance to help you with tuition fees. We invest in your career! Access to a variety of learning programs to continue growing and developing your skills. Thank you for your interest in Hitachi Rail. If your application is of interest, we will be in contact. Please do not hesitate to discover more about us and our latest jobs at https://www.hitachirail.com/careers . At Hitachi Rail, there is a place for everyone. We welcome and value differences in background, age, gender, sexuality, family status, disability, race, nationality, ethnicity, religion, and world view. It is our commitment to create an inclusive environment - we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We would be delighted if you would be one of our followers at https://www.linkedin.com/company/hitachirail Apply Now

69408c7f4da056a4.description: About the Role WSP is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer-Transportation to join the Construction Supervision team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the delivery of electrical systems for a major roads and highways infrastructure project, ensuring adherence to project specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and client expectations. Role Context and Scope The successful candidate will play a key role in site supervision, working closely with contractors, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the construction phase. The position requires extensive experience in large-scale transportation and infrastructure projects, focusing on electrical systems. Key Responsibilities Supervise and monitor all electrical construction activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements, and applicable standards. Inspect and oversee installation works related to highway electrical systems, including street lighting, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), traffic signal infrastructure, power distribution, electrical substations, communication networks, and tunnel/roadway electrical systems. Review contractor shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and work procedures. Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits to ensure works are delivered in accordance with project requirements. Monitor contractor performance and progress against approved construction schedules. Provide technical guidance and support to site teams, clients, and contractors on electrical engineering matters. Review and resolve technical queries, RFIs, non-conformance reports, and design-related issues. Coordinate with design teams to address construction challenges and ensure effective implementation of approved solutions. Participate in value engineering and constructability reviews where required. Ensure all electrical works comply with project specifications, local regulations, Saudi standards, and international engineering best practices. Verify testing and commissioning activities and witness factory acceptance tests (FATs) and site acceptance tests (SATs) as required. Prepare and review inspection reports, test reports, snagging lists, and commissioning documentation. Support project closeout activities and final handover documentation. Liaise with clients, contractors, utility authorities, and relevant government agencies. Attend progress meetings, technical workshops, and coordination meetings with project stakeholders. Support interface management for utility diversions and integration with other infrastructure systems. Promote and maintain the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental compliance on site. Ensure all electrical installations are executed in accordance with approved HSE procedures and project safety requirements. Participate in safety inspections, incident investigations, and risk assessments as required. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 15 years of professional experience in electrical engineering. Proven experience working with leading international engineering consultancy firms. Significant experience in construction supervision and site-based roles. Demonstrated experience on major roads, highways, transportation, or infrastructure projects. Previous experience working in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is essential. Strong understanding of electrical systems associated with transport and infrastructure projects. Experience coordinating with contractors, utility authorities, and government stakeholders. Proven track record of delivering projects within quality, safety, and schedule requirements. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within WSP's Construction Supervision team. Application Information WSP invites qualified candidates to apply for this Senior Electrical Engineer-Transportation role.

6978ba167c2b3957.description: About Johnson & Johnson and the Cardiovascular Team At Johnson & Johnson, the focus is on healthcare innovation to prevent, treat, and cure complex diseases, develop smarter and less invasive treatments, and provide personalized solutions. Educate customers on electrophysiology products to optimize effective usage through technical and clinical information and in-service training. Collaborate with peers to share best practices and enhance customer value. Identify potential sales opportunities within accounts using consultative selling techniques. Create awareness of electrophysiology solutions and facilitate Territory Sales Manager (TM) contact with key decision-makers to drive incremental business. Maximize customer case support capability through proper planning and scheduling. Drive collaboration and maintain communication with the local team (TM and other CAS), support team (Ultrasound CAS, FSE, RBD), and other internal and external partners. Develop and share best practices with KSA Field Sales and Service colleagues and internal partners. Develop and grow customer relationships within and beyond the EP lab, including physicians, nurses, technicians, and hospital administrators. Stay current on company product instructions for use (IFU), best practices, technical troubleshooting, relevant scientific clinical literature, and new product information. Prioritize and respond to requests in high-stress environments, maintaining composure and problem-solving focus. The specialist will operate within a dynamic environment, requiring significant regional travel and direct engagement with medical professionals and patients. The role emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and adherence to company and regulatory standards for health, safety, and environmental practices.

69370466d7747896.description: About Botanica and Red Sea Global Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. The company focuses on integrating new species with local flora and operates with a planet-first approach to sustainability. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a target of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea and Amaala in Tabuk, Umluj. The team includes 40% local community members and is committed to ecological harmony. Role Summary The Director Production will lead plant production at Botanica Red Sea. This full-time role involves overseeing the growth and supply of plant material from the 180-hectare nursery, which has an annual production capacity of 8 million plants. Key responsibilities include managing propagation, greenhouses, shade houses, flower and indoor plant production, the seed bank, and the native species program. The Director is also responsible for leading R&D and biosecurity initiatives. This position is accountable for plant quality, availability, biosecurity, safety, and production cost, ensuring supply to both internal Red Sea Global clients and external developments. Key Responsibilities Translate demand plans into production, import, and growing plans (propagation, growing cycles, mother stock, imports) with the PMO. Achieve production volumes, plant readiness dates, germination, and survival targets; manage live plant inventory with accurate stock records. Review plant Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for all Red Sea Global and external projects; confirm availability, substitutions, and lead times. Agree on weekly readiness and dispatch schedules with the Director – Nursery Operations. Lead plant propagation (seed, cuttings, grafting, layering, division), greenhouses, shade houses, flower and food production, indoor plants, and the seed bank. Grow the native plant program and increase the share of native production. Apply crop management practices (scheduling, fertilization, IPM) to maximize quality and minimize losses. Own the Biosecurity Protocol, including inspection of incoming and imported material, phytosanitary documentation, quarantine, hygiene, and traceability. Lead the integrated pest and disease management (IPM) program and the R&D roadmap (propagation techniques, substrates, irrigation, climate-resilient species). Ensure compliance with MEWA requirements and the use of approved species only. Manage the direct cost budget for nursery production and R&D; control labor, materials, water, fuel, equipment, and wastage. Plan manpower, equipment, and materials with the PMO; report utilization and productivity weekly. Identify cost and delivery risks early and propose corrective actions. Lead managers, supervisors, horticulturists, and operatives across nursery production and R&D; drive competency, training, and supervision standards. Deliver the fixed responsibilities of a Department Head (Section *** Follow and enforce all relevant Botanica and Red Sea Global Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Apply and champion the safety, quality, and environmental management system (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Agriculture, Landscape Architecture, or Agricultural Engineering; Master's degree preferred. Minimum of 15 years of experience in large-scale nursery or horticultural production, with at least 7 years leading production operations with a workforce of 100 or more. 69b032ffdf987e4d.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة مصنع شرفان الحديث للعطورات عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى بائع عطور في فرعها بالرياض، وتحديداً في سوق المعيقلية. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب العمل بنظام الفترتين الصباحية والمسائية لخدمة العملاء وتقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء وتقديم خدمة احترافية لهم. مساعدة العملاء في اختيار العطور المناسبة لاحتياجاتهم وتفضيلاتهم. عرض المنتجات وترتيبها بشكل جذاب، والمحافظة على المظهر العام للمحل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة سابقة في مجال العطور (تفضل الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة). مهارات تواصل وإقناع ممتازة. القدرة على الالتزام والانضباط بمواعيد العمل المحددة. الاستعداد للعمل بنظام الورديات (فترتين صباحية ومسائية). بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في مدينة الرياض، سوق المعيقلية. يتطلب الدور التواجد في المتجر خلال فترتين عمل يومياً، صباحية ومسائية، لضمان تغطية ساعات العمل وخدمة العملاء بفعالية. التقديم الراتب مجزٍ وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال المقابلة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الشاغر.

69d4783316a173c2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة موشن آند هيلينغ بريدج عن أخصائي علاج طبيعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية، ووضع خطط العلاج الطبيعي، ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج للمرضى. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الحالة المرضية بشكل شامل، ووضع خطة وبرنامج علاجي طبيعي مخصص لكل حالة. متابعة تنفيذ خطة العلاج الطبيعي، وتسجيل البيانات العلاجية بشكل دقيق لتقييم التقدم المحرز. تدريب المصاب وذويه على كيفية إجراء التمارين والحركات العلاجية اللازمة في المنزل. ضبط وتنظيم الأجهزة والمعدات المستخدمة في العلاج الطبيعي لضمان فعاليتها وسلامتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالعلاج الطبيعي وحفظها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. تحديد التمارين والحركات التقويمية اللازمة وتحديد معدلات تكرارها بالتنسيق مع الطبيب المعالج. تدليك المرضى لتحسين أداء عضلات الجسم المصاب وتدريبهم على استخدام الأثقال وبكرات الشد والآلات الرياضية وجهاز العوارض. تنفيذ الحركات الأرضية لتقوية عضلات الأطراف والظهر والعنق. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال العلاج الطبيعي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في وضع خطط العلاج ومتابعة تنفيذها. القدرة على تدريب المرضى وذويهم على التمارين العلاجية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل فعالة مع المرضى والزملاء. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. مهارات تنظيمية وإعداد تقارير دقيقة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي العلاج الطبيعي في شركة موشن آند هيلينغ بريدج بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور للانضمام إلى فريقنا.

69144b2b722a8b44.description: About the Role Front End Limited Company is seeking an experienced Heavy Equipment Operator – Sideboom for a full-time, on-site position in Dhahran, Eastern Province. This role is critical for pipeline construction projects, focusing on the safe and efficient handling of pipes along the right-of-way. Role Context and Impact The Sideboom Operator plays a key role in supporting stringing, welding, coating, and lowering-in operations during pipeline construction. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining spread progress while strictly adhering to lifting safety standards on site. Preference will be given to Aramco-approved operators. Key Responsibilities Operating the sideboom in strict accordance with the manufacturer's load chart and approved lift plans. Holding pipe in precise alignment for the welding front, ensuring no shock loading occurs. Executing coordinated multi-machine lifts to lower welded strings into the trench. Completing documented pre-use inspections each shift and promptly reporting any defects. Assessing ground bearing capacity and stability prior to positioning the equipment. Working effectively to signals from the designated rigger under the direct supervision of the Pipeline Foreman and Lifting Supervisor. Qualifications and Experience A strong background in pipeline construction operations, including stringing, welding support, lowering-in, tie-ins, and crossings. Proficiency in machine inspection and operator-level maintenance, with disciplined defect reporting and daily log keeping. Demonstrated ability to assess ground conditions, gradient, and trench-edge proximity, and to work safely alongside adjacent machines and crews. Ability to receive and confirm hand and radio signals, and to comprehend permit and lift-plan briefings. A commitment to stop-work authority, exclusion zone discipline, and full PPE compliance at all times. Experience required: 5-10 years. Desirable Attributes Cross-country transmission pipeline experience on large diameter (24 inch and above) projects is highly desirable. Prior work on Saudi Aramco scope with a main contractor is highly desirable. Work Environment This role requires a willingness to work extended shifts, six days per week, on a camp-based rotation in remote right-of-way locations. The position is full-time and based on-site in Dhahran.

69c069766c2317f2.job_title: Assistant Manager - Finance and Procurement Operations Business Partner
69c069766c2317f2.description: The Assistant Manager – Finance and Procurement Operations Business Partner supports the Marketing function in managing its financial planning, procurement activities, vendor relationships, and operational requirements. The role acts as the main coordination point between Marketing and Finance, Procurement, Legal, and external suppliers to ensure budgets, purchase requests, contracts, purchase orders, and payments are managed efficiently and in accordance with organizational policies. Maintain accurate records of vendor contracts, purchase orders, deliverables, payment schedules, and contract expiry dates. Support the resolution of vendor disputes, delayed deliverables, invoice discrepancies, and payment issues. Coordinate with Marketing teams to obtain confirmation of services and approvals before processing payments. Track invoices and payments and follow up with Finance, Procurement, and vendors on outstanding items. Maintain accurate records of financial commitments, invoices, accruals, and payment status. Support the timely resolution of blocked, rejected, or incorrectly submitted invoices. Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management Act as the main operational link between Marketing and Finance, Procurement, Legal, and other corporate functions. Advise Marketing stakeholders on relevant financial, procurement, and contracting processes. Support Marketing teams in planning procurement lead times and selecting the appropriate sourcing approach. Facilitate regular budget and procurement review meetings with Marketing stakeholders. Provide clear updates to management on budget status, procurement progress, risks, and required decisions. Build effective relationships with internal teams, agencies, suppliers, and service providers. Governance, Compliance and Reporting Ensure all Marketing financial and procurement activities comply with organizational policies, delegated authorities, and approval requirements. Maintain complete and accurate documentation to support governance reviews and internal or external audits. Develop and maintain trackers, dashboards, reports, and operational records for budgets, contracts, purchase orders, and payments. Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, visibility, and compliance. Support the development of standardized templates, guidelines, and working procedures for Marketing operations. Monitor key operational indicators, including procurement turnaround time, budget utilization, payment status, and vendor performance. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Professional certification in Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, or Project Management is an advantage. Minimum of 4–6 years of relevant experience in finance operations, procurement, commercial operations, business partnering, or budget management. Previous experience supporting a Marketing, Communications, Events, Media, or Sponsorships function is preferred. Experience managing budgets, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and vendor relationships.
